name: UK strikes & disruption
value: Consultant strike paused; Tube strikes 26 Nov
summary: BMA paused the 25–27 Nov consultant strike on 11 Nov for talks; London Tube driver strikes start 26 Nov
state: The BMA said on 11 Nov that consultants in England had paused the strike planned for 25–27 Nov to enter formal negotiations with the government, while warning further action could follow if talks stall (BMA; NHS Employers). RMT Tube drivers have set eight 24-hour London Underground strikes, the first from noon on 26 Nov (Rus Tourism News, 13 Nov). With no national-scale strike or nationwide disruption due, the signal returns to Normal.
for_you: London commuters and visitors face Tube disruption on the announced strike dates from 26 Nov; TfL publishes travel advice. Planned NHS care in England is no longer affected by the consultant walkout, though the dispute is unresolved.
rubric_hit: Normal: no national-scale strikes or disruption this week; consultant strike paused 11 Nov, Tube strikes are London-only
